messages:
ashley (CS): Heads up — ACME flagged that a $750 trial promo ended up on an old workspace after their SSO consolidation. Ticket CS-8877001.
michael (ACME): Quote: "Clicked our company promo and it showed on an old dev sandbox (acme-old-sandbox). We need that moved to acme-main please."
audit-bot: redeem_event: promo=ACME-WELCOME-750, redeemer=ci-deploy@acme.com, target_workspace=acme-old-sandbox, ts=2046123456
ashley (CS): Hmm, redeemer is a CI service account. Did they paste the link into a CI job? @sam (infra) can you check workspace state and who owns that workspace row?
sam (infra): quick lookup: SELECT id, org_id, state, promo_balance_cents, last_redeem_by FROM workspaces WHERE slug='acme-old-sandbox';
-- result: id=wk_402, org_id=org_777, state=archived, promo_balance_cents=75000, last_redeem_by='ci-deploy@acme.com'
sam (infra): looks like stale workspace row still belonged to org_777; ACME's SSO merge moved most assets to org_888 but some archived workspace rows didn't get org_id updated. Promo service allowed redemption to archived workspace.
nick (billing): Recommended remediation: move promo_balance to org_888's wallet and zero the workspace balance. Also fail promo redemptions to non-active workspaces. Approve for immediate run?
ashley (CS): Approve. Customer wants this today. Please include brief customer note and ETA.
paul (eng): Running dry-run migration now. SQL we plan to run: 
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE wallets SET balance_cents = balance_cents + 75000 WHERE owner_type='org' AND owner_id='org_888';
UPDATE workspaces SET promo_balance_cents = 0 WHERE id='wk_402';
INSERT INTO audit_logs (actor, action, details) VALUES ('promo-migration-bot', 'migrate_promo', 'wk_402 -> org_888');
COMMIT;
```
paul (eng): dry-run looks good, applying now. (applied at ts=2046123490)
nick (billing): Verified org_888 wallet increased by $750. Logged under CS-8877001.
ashley (CS): Draft to customer: "Hi Michael — we tracked the $750 promo to an archived sandbox leftover from your SSO merge. We've moved the funds into your primary org wallet (acme-main) and zeroed the archived workspace. You should see the balance in acme-main now. We're also blocking promo redemptions to archived/deactivated workspaces to prevent recurrence."
michael (ACME): Thanks Ashley — confirmed I can see the credit in acme-main. Appreciate the fast fix. Please add the CI guidance too so our infra team can avoid using the link in jobs.
paul (eng): Adding server-side guard: require workspace.state='active' OR target must be org wallet; adding weekly scan job to alert if promo_balance > 0 on non-active workspaces. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4621
ashley (CS): Closing after customer confirms in product. Action items: (1) patch promo service, (2) alerting job, (3) update docs for promo redeem links + CI guidance. Closing CS-8877001.
